lessons.title: Restaurants reply faster on WhatsApp than email
lessons.body: Across the last food & beverage projects, WhatsApp openers got replies within a day while email took a week or never. Lead with a short voice-friendly message and one concrete idea.

lessons.title: Ask for photos at signing, not at kickoff
lessons.body: Two projects slipped because client photos arrived late. Make photos and price lists part of the deposit checklist and offer stock photography as a fallback in the proposal.

lessons.title: Dental clinics care about booking deposits
lessons.body: No-shows are the top pain for clinics. Leading with the booking + deposits add-on and a no-show cost estimate moved two clinics from discovery to proposal.
